error: Could not save. Please try again.
invalid: Enter a valid number within the supported range.
invalidDate: Enter a real date, today or earlier.
deleteConfirm: Delete this record? This cannot be undone.
healthUnavailable: Health sync requires a native development build and a supported health provider.
syncFailed: Sync did not finish. Check health permissions and try again.
healthPrivacy: Body weight syncs both ways with Apple Health or Health Connect. Finished workouts are saved there as strength training, with their times only; sets and loads stay in the app.
syncHelp: Sync imports available body weights and exports the ones you log here. Imported records remain managed by their source. HealthKit may hide records if read access is denied.
syncSchedule: Syncs daily when allowed by your device, and when you open the app if overdue. Background timing depends on system settings.
migrationSafe: Your records were not changed. Save a copy to keep them safe.
setsPerMuscleEmpty: Sets per muscle show up here as you train.
discardEmptyWorkout: Finish and discard this empty workout?
uncheckedSetLeftOut: {n} unchecked set will be left out.
uncheckedSetsLeftOut: {n} unchecked sets will be left out.
discardWorkoutBody: Everything logged in it is deleted.
addFirstExercise: Add your first exercise. Sets fill in from last time.
name: Name
enterRepsBody: Type how many reps you did, then check the set off.
notAtGym: Not at {gym}. Swap or remove it.
undoModelChange: Takes back what the model changed
noSetsFound: No sets found. Try the exercise, then load × reps × sets.
describePlaceholder: bench 225x5x3, incline db 30s for 12 12 10, pull ups bw 3x8
describeNote: Tap the keyboard’s microphone to dictate. Loads without a unit are in {unit}. It is read on this phone.
describeNoteModel: Tap the keyboard’s microphone to dictate. Loads without a unit are in {unit}. It is read on this phone with its own model.
endsStayInHistory: {name} ends. Workouts you did stay in History.
workoutsStayInHistory: Workouts you did stay in History.
trainOnProgramBody: A block of weeks where effort rises, loads and reps are worked out for every set, and sets grow as you recover, then a lighter deload week.
atGymTravel: At {gym}, with stand-ins for what it does not have
blockDoneBody: Run it again with loads carrying over, or build a new one.
travelingPrompt: Pick the gym you will use and your last day there. Sessions adapt until then, and your program carries on when you are back.
addGymNote: Each starts from typical equipment; turn equipment and single exercises on or off to match the real thing.
gymNumbersError: Enter the bar weight and steps as numbers.
pickPlateError: Pick at least one plate size.
workoutsThereStayInHistory: Workouts you did there stay in History.
notAtThisGymNote: Exercises this gym has the equipment for but cannot do, like a leg press it does not have.
alsoAtThisGymNote: Exercises this gym can do although their equipment is not turned on, like its one cable station.
mainGymIsMain: Workouts start here. Make another gym your main one to change it.
mainGymNote: Workouts start here unless a program names another gym or you are traveling.
equipmentHereNote: Programs and swaps only use what this gym has. Loads round to its plates and steps.
nothingToPick: Nothing to pick with this equipment.
travelSheetIntro: Program sessions swap each exercise this gym cannot do for the closest one it can, with loads it can make. Your program keeps its place. Back home, loads pick up from before you left.
savedAsNewGym: Saved as a new gym. Change it under Gyms in Settings.
travelBannerBody: Through {date}. Sessions use what is there; your usual loads pick up when you are back.
builderPlaceholder: 4 days, an hour, only dumbbells, bad left shoulder, bigger arms, smaller quads
builderNoModel: Without an on-device model, only days, minutes and weeks are read.
bringUpNote: Up to {n}. They get more sets and are never cut for time.
bringDownNote: Trained less, and their sets do not grow week to week.
builderFinalNote: Exercises come from the gym you picked and skip ones marked Avoid. When you travel, sessions swap in what the other gym has. You can change anything next.
allowCameraProgram: Allow camera access in Settings to photograph a page.
noTextFound: No text found. Try a flatter, closer photo.
noProgramFound: No exercises with sets and reps found, like “Bench Press 3x6-8”.
importPlaceholder:
Day 1 – Upper
Bench Press 3x6-8
Chest-Supported Row 3x8-12

Day 2 – Lower
Squat 4x5
importNote: Paste or photograph it; it is read on this phone. Loads come from your own history once you train, not from the page.
emptyDayBody: Give every day at least one exercise, or remove the day.
gymStandInsNote: Sessions swap in stand-ins for exercises this gym cannot do.
setsRiseNote: Sets rise week to week when you recover well and hit your reps.
sessionNotInProgram: This session is not in your program anymore.
anotherWorkoutOpen: Another workout is in progress. Finish it to start this one.
notNextYet: Not next yet: targets can still change with what you log before then.
adviceStalled: {reason}. Behind {n} sessions running: a swap may help
adviceFirst: First time: pick a load you could do {max} times, stop at {reps}
adviceTopOut: Top of the range; the next load up is a big jump, so hold {reps}
adviceDeload: Deload: lighter and easy, to recover for the next block
strengthTrendEmpty: A strength trend appears once you have done this on two different days.
strengthChartSummary: {name}, estimated one-rep max from {from} to {to}. Low {min}, high {max}. Latest: {value}, {direction}.
heatmapHint: Tap a square for its number.
strengthEmpty: Your most-trained lifts show up here.
recordsEmpty: Beat an earlier session and it lands here.
muscleFeedbackNote: Optional: how much it was, then how sore you were coming in. Next week’s sets follow this; skip it and your reps decide.
modelNoAnswer: The on-device model did not answer. Your note is saved.
sessionNotePlaceholder: Elbow was cranky on skull crushers, bench flew up
noExerciseMatchesAddOwn: No exercise matches. Add your own from the Exercises tab.
moreSearchToNarrow: {n} more · search or filter to narrow
movementHint: Swaps suggest exercises with the same movement.
musclesHint: Tap once for a primary muscle (a full set), twice for secondary (half a set).
pickPrimaryMuscle: Pick at least one primary muscle.
enterRepRange: Enter a rep range such as 8 to 12.
avoidHint: Left out of swap suggestions, e.g. when it hurts.
localOnlyNote: Vector Lift keeps everything on this phone. No account, no servers.
backupIntro: An encrypted file you save wherever you like. There is no cloud copy and no password recovery.
backupPasswordHint: At least 10 characters. It cannot be recovered.
backupPasswordLength: Use a password between 10 and 256 characters.
backupSavedNote: The backup is saved only if you picked a place for it in the share sheet.
restoreReplacesNote: Replaces your workouts, programs, exercises, gyms and weights, and turns Health sync off. A recovery copy of what you have now is saved first.
replaceEverythingBody: Your current workouts, programs and weights are replaced by this backup. A recovery copy is saved first.
restoredNote: Restored. What you had before is in the recovery backup below, with the same password.
csvNote: Readable in a spreadsheet, unencrypted, and not a restore format.
eraseBody: Deletes your workouts, programs, exercises, gyms, weights, settings and recovery backups. It cannot be undone; save a backup first to keep them. Files you already shared and Apple Health or Health Connect records are not touched.
invalidValue: {field}: enter a number above 0 and up to {max}.
trendChartSummary: Trend weight from {from} to {to}. Low {min}, high {max}. Latest: {value}, {direction}.
